correctness.rationale: Every projection onto the zero-row/column kernel symmetrizes without increasing either target norm. Orbit equations for the stabilizer of a single edge and identity on the kernel force uniqueness of the invariant projection Q=C_m X C_n. Matrix coefficients yield 4α and 1+2α exactly; symmetry gives ℓ∞; rank-one tensors establish factorization at every ℓp; orthogonal projections establish p=2. All m,n≥2, including endpoints, are covered analytically. The bundled exact rational checker was executed successfully on 71 cases but is supplementary.

value.rationale: Theorem classifies both least projection and complementary projection costs simultaneously for a natural infinite family of graph circulation kernels. Across all real ℓp exponents the unique equivariant optimal map factorizes; two sharp endpoint constants exhibit a precise parameter crossover and distinct 4-versus-3 large-graph limits. This addresses two independent natural Banach complementation invariants, not an arbitrary finite slice.
